intro: Real help across Brevard County, taken from each organization’s own website. For anything not listed, call or text 211 Brevard — it covers housing, food, utilities, health care, disaster help and more, 24 hours a day.
verified_note: Every listing below was checked on the organization’s own website in October 2026. Phone numbers only seen in search results were left out. If a number is wrong, telling us fixes it for every neighbor after you.

resources.name: 211 Brevard
resources.what: 24/7 helpline for housing, food, utilities, health care, disaster help, mental health and addiction. Call 211, or text your ZIP code to 898211. 211brevard.org

resources.name: 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline
resources.what: Call or text 988, any time. Listed by 211 Brevard as a text option.

resources.name: Serene Harbor
resources.what: Domestic violence help: emergency shelter, counseling, legal advocacy, support groups, and help relocating. The hotline takes calls, texts and TTY. sereneharbor.org

resources.name: Circles of Care
resources.what: Mental health and substance use care. For life-threatening emergencies, call 911. circlesofcare.org

resources.name: Providence Connects (formerly the South Brevard Sharing Center)
resources.what: Food, housing and emergency rental help. providenceconnects.org

resources.name: Housing Authority of Brevard County
resources.what: Section 8 housing vouchers and public housing. habc.us

resources.name: Brevard Homeless Coalition
resources.what: Works to make homelessness “rare, brief and non-recurring.” Housing help starts with a call to 211. brevardhomelesscoalition.org

resources.name: Brevard Health Alliance
resources.what: Community health centers for adults and children, including people without insurance. Melbourne locations on Sarno Rd, Silver Palm Ave, Valentine St and S Grant St. brevardhealth.org

resources.name: Florida Department of Health in Brevard — Melbourne clinic
resources.what: Family planning, shots, STI testing and WIC. brevard.floridahealth.gov

resources.name: Aging Matters in Brevard
resources.what: Meals on Wheels, rides, in-home help and home repairs for seniors. agingmattersbrevard.org

resources.name: Space Coast Area Transit
resources.what: County buses, with reduced fares for riders 60 and older ($0.75 a ride), and door-to-door paratransit for people with disabilities, seniors, or low income who find it hard to travel alone. 321transit.com

resources.name: Melbourne Vet Center (VA)
resources.what: Free counseling for veterans and families — PTSD, depression, military sexual trauma, grief. va.gov/melbourne-vet-center

resources.name: Brevard County Legal Aid
resources.what: Free civil legal help for people who qualify. South County office in Melbourne. brevardcountylegalaid.org

resources.name: Brevard County Sheriff — non-emergency and jail information
resources.what: Jail information, inmate records and visitation. For emergencies, call 911. brevardsheriff.com

resources.name: Brevard County Utility Services
resources.what: County sewer and water service accounts.

resources.name: Brevard Supervisor of Elections
resources.what: Voter registration, mail ballots, polling places. votebrevard.gov
